tldr: Evening batch (Aug 27): the pre-IPO compute-capex war hits its biggest single line — Anthropic locks ~$45B over six years with Nscale (460MW, Vera Rubin from late 2027) — and Z.ai reveals GLM-5.3-Flash ran all its 100T-token/day Ox Alpha traffic on Chinese silicon, the strongest open-weights × non-Nvidia proof point yet. Google's Gemini 3.5 Transcribe auto-cleans speech across 85 languages at 5.5% WER, and Claude Cowork gets its own in-app browser for portal automation. The Nvidia–Hugging Face fallout reaches the community: r/LocalLLaMA debates torrenting model files, a 4×DGX-cluster owner swaps DeepSeek V4 0731 for Qwen3.8-Flash and GLM-5.3-Flash (Qwen wins), and NVIDIA NeMo + LightSeek ship day-0 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next support.

articles.title: Anthropic locks in $45B Nscale compute deal ahead of IPO
articles.summary: ~$45B over six years for 460MW at Nscale's Monarch campus, running Vera Rubin from late 2027 — the pre-IPO compute war's biggest single commitment.

articles.title: Google launches Gemini 3.5 Transcribe — 85 languages, auto-cleans your speech
articles.summary: Replaces Chirp 3: 85 languages, strips filler words and self-corrections live, 5.5% streaming WER, 70% lower latency, delegates via function calling.

articles.title: Claude Cowork now runs its own browser inside the desktop app
articles.summary: Side-panel browser where Claude loads pages, clicks, types and fills forms with no API — separate from your real browser; banking/email blocked.

articles.title: GLM-5.3-Flash ran entirely on Chinese chips — a CUDA-moat test
articles.summary: Z.ai: all Ox Alpha traffic (100T tokens/day peak) ran on Chinese AI silicon at Nvidia-parity efficiency — $0.09/task at 57 Intelligence Index.

articles.title: r/LocalLLaMA weighs torrents for hosting model files
articles.summary: After Nvidia's HF acquisition, the community debates torrenting model files — distributed hosting as insurance against hub-policy shifts.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4 0731 → Qwen3.8-Flash → GLM-5.3-Flash: one cluster's verdict
articles.summary: Hands-on on a 4×DGX cluster: GLM-5.3-Flash too verbose at ~22 tok/s, Qwen3.8-Flash wins — and the owner returns to DeepSeek V4 0731.

articles.title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next gets day-0 NVIDIA NeMo + LightSeek support
articles.summary: NVIDIA NeMo + LightSeek ship day-0 fine-tune/inference recipes for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (FP8 N-gram embedding) — Qwen4 infra-ready on launch.
